summary: AbbVie Inc. filed an 8-K to report completion of an underwritten public offering of senior notes, including floating rate notes due 2028 and various fixed-rate tranches due 2028 through 2066, totaling $10 billion. The offering was registered under an existing S-3ASR shelf and is governed by the base indenture dated November 8, 2012, supplemented by Supplemental Indenture No. 13. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. There are no terms related to mergers, acquisitions, buybacks, or restructuring. The filing is informational only under Item 8.01, with no impact on equity holders or corporate control.
